build_Llama: build a Llama model instance from checkpoint directory and tokenizer path with model parallel support
generate_Llama_generate: generate token sequences from prompt tokens using temperature sampling and top-p nucleus sampling
complete_Llama_text_completion: complete text prompts by generating continuations with configurable temperature and top-p parameters
infill_Llama_text_infilling: infill missing text between a prefix and suffix using the Llama infilling model
chat_Llama_chat_completion: complete a multi-turn chat dialog with system user and assistant message roles
